meta.title: PetPanic — Try the app | Closed beta

hero.badge: Closed beta — pilot with animal shelters
hero.title:
If they get lost,
the whole neighbourhood looks.
hero.lead: When you raise an alert, PetPanic sends a notification to everyone with the app within 5 km and an email to the animal shelters in your area that have signed up.
hero.note: No card needed. Searching is always free.

whatIs.title: Don't let your alert end up on a lamppost.
whatIs.problem: A message in your building's WhatsApp group or a poster taped to a lamppost only reaches whoever walks past. Meanwhile, your pet keeps moving.
whatIs.solution: PetPanic sends your alert to everyone with the app within 5 km and to the shelters in the area that have signed up. Nothing to print. No waiting for someone to share it.

register.title: Register your pet
register.desc: A photo, their name and a few basic details.

alert.title: If they get lost, raise an alert
alert.desc: One button. The app picks up your location and creates the alert straight away.

notify.title: We let people nearby know
notify.desc: Everyone with PetPanic within 5 km gets a notification, and the shelters in the area that have signed up get an email.

together.title: Search together
together.desc: In the alert's chat, anyone who spots your pet can message you and send photos. Once they turn up, you mark the alert as resolved.

nearby.title: Alerts within 5 km
nearby.desc: The notification only reaches people with PetPanic within 5 km of the alert. No spam, no noise.

shelters.title: Local shelters
shelters.desc: Shelters in your area that have signed up get your alert by email.

chat.title: Alert chat
chat.desc: Every alert has its own chat, with photos, so anyone who sees your pet can tell you.

tag.title: QR tag
tag.desc: If someone finds your pet and scans their tag, they see your pet's profile and, if your pet is lost, your phone number.

friends.title: Friends network
friends.desc: Connect with other people who have pets. Included in PetPanic Social.

walks.title: Walking zones
walks.desc: Save the places where you usually go for walks. Included in PetPanic Social.

pilot.title: Did your shelter send you this link?
pilot.intro: You're one of the first people trying PetPanic. What you tell us decides what we fix and what comes first.

install.title: Install the app.
install.play: Available on <link>Google Play (testing track)</link>. On iPhone, use the web version for now.
install.web: We're finishing our Google Play listing. Until then, you can use the web version by opening <link>app.petpanic.es</link> on your phone.

use.desc: Register your pet, raise a test alert, connect with friends, check the map. Whatever you'd really do.

tell.title: Tell us.
tell.desc_one: At the end of the pilot we'll send you a short form ({{count}} minute) so you can tell us what you liked and what you didn't. If something doesn't work during the pilot, email us directly at <mail>{{email}}</mail>.
tell.desc_other: At the end of the pilot we'll send you a short form ({{count}} minutes) so you can tell us what you liked and what you didn't. If something doesn't work during the pilot, email us directly at <mail>{{email}}</mail>.

perks.title: What's in it for you
perks.trial: 30 days of PetPanic Social free, no card needed: walking zones and friends. After that, if you want to keep it, €4.99/month or €39.99/year.
perks.free: Searching is always free. You don't have to pay anything to take part in the pilot.
perks.team: A direct line to the team. If something doesn't feel right, write to us and we'll look at it with you.

free.a: Searching is always free. PetPanic Social, with walking zones and friends, costs €4.99/month or €39.99/year, with 30 days free and no card needed. You don't need it for the pilot.

data.a: Your data is hosted on European servers (Supabase, eu-west-2). When you raise an alert, its location goes to people with PetPanic within 5 km. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

iphone.a: The web version (app.petpanic.es) works on iPhone. The native iOS app isn't ready yet; we'll email you when it's available on TestFlight.

noPet.q: I'm a shelter member but I don't have a pet. Can I take part?
noPet.a: Yes. You can sign up without a pet of your own and use the app to help when someone raises an alert in your area. That's exactly what we most need to test.

duration.q: How long does the pilot last?
duration.a: Three weeks of active use plus one to wrap up. Then you decide whether to stay, no strings attached.

cta.title: Shall we start?
cta.text: If you've made it this far, you're already part of the pilot. All that's left is to open the app.
